entries.symptom: The first version of case 00161 started with B = 0.  COPASI's Jacobian uses steps relative to each variable's value, so the column for a variable whose value is 0 comes out as 0 (wrong); the translator's COPASI backend refuses with 'COPASI cannot differentiate with respect to B: its value is 0' and the script exits with an error.  roadrunner gave the correct matrix [[-1, 0], [1, -2]].  Checked directly against COPASI 4.48 with the chain model at B = 0: the column for B comes out as [0, 0] for derivation factors from 1e-3 to 1e-12 (dB'/dB should be -2), so it does not depend on the step size.  Not yet checked against COPASI's own steady-state task report.  Reported to the COPASI developers by the maintainer on 2026-10-09; to be discussed further.
entries.resolution: Left the COPASI backend refusing (an error is better than a wrong matrix).  Case 00161 now starts with A = 1, B = 0.5, which tests the same thing (the Jacobian of this linear model does not depend on the state), so that every backend that supports Jacobians can run it.  A zero-valued species in a Jacobian remains unsupported on COPASI.  (The case was renumbered when the suite's numbers were reassigned in order of addition: it was 00005 and is now 00161.)

entries.symptom: The model resets S to 5 with an SBML event at time 2.  OpenCOR's result keeps decaying from 10 (S(2.5) = 2.865 instead of 3.894): sbml2cellml 0.4.2 converts the model to CellML without the event and without any warning, and libopencor then runs the converted model.  roadrunner and COPASI apply the event and agree with the closed form.
entries.resolution: The translator's OpenCOR backend now refuses a model that has SBML events: the generated script exits with status 11 and the message 'skip: opencor cannot run the model: ...', which the suite runner reports as a skip.  Case 00123 runs on roadrunner and COPASI only.  Deliberately not reported: the sbml2cellml developers are working on translating at least some events.

entries.symptom: BoundedODESimulation on roadrunner 2.10.0 (variable_step_size = true, CVODE, relative tolerance 1e-10, absolute 1e-12): the last row, at the end of the span, is 1.2e-4 (relative) away from the analytic value, outside the case's tolerance (absolute 1e-7, relative 1e-4).  All 194 rows before it are within 2.8e-8.  The same happens with the rk45 integrator in variable-step mode (1.0e-4).  Case 00136 (a chain) is within tolerance at 1.3e-5.  Case 00135 is the reproduction (decay, S' = -0.5 S, S(0) = 10; independentVariableSpan 0 to 10).
entries.resolution: The translator's roadrunner backend returns the rows exactly as roadrunner gives them.  An earlier version integrated the end point again and substituted it, which hid this; that was removed (CLAUDE.md, never hide a problem).  Case 00135 is unchanged and roadrunner is no longer one of its admitted backends; copasi still is.  Not yet reported to the roadrunner developers (a report is drafted).
